entry_criteria: Raw quarterly settlement extracts have been received from all 9 portfolio segments in CSV/Parquet format with headers matching schema v2.1.
All files are timestamped, version-tagged, and delivered via secure transfer to the risk analytics shared storage (S3: risk-data/quarterly-extracts/Q4-2024).
exit_criteria: All extracts have been parsed into a unified data lake with schema validation logs confirming field mapping against the approved extract specification.
A master data dictionary has been generated and published to Confluence under 'Data Definitions: Q4 2024 Extracts'.

workstreams.name: Extract Parsing and Schema Alignment
dependencies: Raw extracts are available and accessible in S3 by 2024-10-05T08:00:00Z
workstreams.coverage: All 9 portfolio segments, including holiday-season projection window (60-day range).

workstreams.name: Data Quality Checks and Outlier Flagging
dependencies: Parsing and schema alignment completed in the prior workstream
workstreams.coverage: All segments; all chargeback ratios, decline rates, reserve balances.

hard: Data dictionary v2.1 is published before parsing begins
soft: System-level validation scripts are running in the data lake environment

phases.negative_space: This phase does not include reconciliation of chargeback ratios or reserve adequacy calculations; those occur in subsequent phases.
phases.ordering_rule: Segments processed in order of segment ID (01 to 99), as defined in the extract metadata.
phases.rounding_rule: All intermediate values are rounded to two decimal places at point of aggregation, with no rounding applied before final output.

entry_criteria: All raw data has passed validation and quality checks; outlier flags have been reviewed and documented.
The data lake contains fully parsed, validated, and outlier-flagged datasets for all 9 segments.
exit_criteria: Chargeback ratios (0.31% to 1.02%) are computed per segment with units labeled as percentage (%), and decline curves by bin range are derived from raw authorization data.
All computed ratios are stored in a verification table with traceable source columns.

workstreams.name: Chargeback Ratio Calculation
dependencies: Data ingestion and validation phase completed
workstreams.coverage: All 9 segments; chargeback ratios against scheme threshold of 0.90%.

workstreams.name: Authorization Decline Curve Derivation
dependencies: Raw authorization data is available and parsed in the data lake
workstreams.coverage: All 9 segments; decline rates by bin range (0–5%, 5–10%, etc.).

hard: Raw authorization data is available and parsed
soft: Modeling scripts are tested against a sample segment (Segment 03)

phases.negative_space: This phase does not compute reserve adequacy or perform override assessments; those occur in the next phase.
phases.ordering_rule: Segments processed in order of segment ID (01 to 99).
phases.rounding_rule: All ratios and decline rates are reported with two decimal places; units explicitly labeled as percentage (%).

phases.phase_name: Reserve Adequacy Assessment and Override Review
entry_criteria: Chargeback ratios and decline curves have been computed and verified.
Reserve balances and required floors are available in the data lake.
exit_criteria: All reserve adequacy assessments are completed with explicit units (basis points, bp), and every override is justified by reference to an appetite paragraph (e.g., Appetite 4.2).
Override rationale is documented in a separate table with full traceability to the scheme rule or internal policy.

workstreams.name: Reserve Adequacy Calculation
dependencies: Chargeback ratios and decline curves computed in prior phase
workstreams.coverage: All 9 segments; reserve balances vs required floors.

workstreams.name: Override Justification and Rationale Documentation
dependencies: Reserve adequacy calculations completed and validated
workstreams.coverage: All segments where reserve balance falls below required floor; every override references a specific appetite paragraph.

hard: Reserve balances available in data lake
soft: Appetite document v2.1 is accessible and current

phases.negative_space: This phase does not include reconciliation of totals or final verdicts; those are performed in the final phase.
phases.ordering_rule: Segments processed in order of segment ID (01 to 99).
phases.rounding_rule: All reserve values reported in basis points (bp); unit labels required in every column.

entry_criteria: All ratios, decline curves, and reserve adequacy assessments are computed and override justifications are documented.
All data is traceable to raw extracts or stated assumptions.
exit_criteria: All totals (e.g., segment-level chargeback sum) reconcile with component values; mismatches are flagged as hard errors.
Each portfolio segment receives a verdict: within-appetite, watch, breach-imminent, or breach — using fixed vocabulary and explicitly tied to appetite paragraph.

workstreams.name: Total Reconciliation
dependencies: Reserve adequacy and override assessments completed
workstreams.coverage: All 9 segments; all totals must match component-level sums.

workstreams.name: Verdict Assignment and Final Output
dependencies: All reconciliation checks pass with no mismatches
workstreams.coverage: All 9 segments; verdicts assigned using fixed vocabulary and appetite references.

hard: No data gaps or missing inputs exist in raw extracts
soft: Final output is tested against a sample segment (Segment 03)

phases.negative_space: This phase does not include external reporting to scheme networks; that occurs post-approval and is outside the scope of this review.
phases.ordering_rule: Segments processed in order of segment ID (01 to 99).
phases.rounding_rule: All final outputs are rounded to two decimal places, with units explicitly labeled.

critical_path.sequence: Data Ingestion and Validation → Ratio Computation and Verification → Reserve Adequacy Assessment and Override Review → Final Reconciliation and Verdict Assignment
hard_dependencies: Data dictionary v2.1 published before parsing begins
Chargeback ratios computed before reserve adequacy assessment
Reserve adequacy assessments completed before final reconciliation
soft_dependencies: Modeling scripts tested against sample segment (Segment 03)
Appetite document v2.1 accessible and current

derived_dates.reason_for_slip_threshold: If any hard dependency is delayed by more than 2 days, the critical path must be recomputed to ensure all ratios and reserves are still within valid input windows.

risk_register.description: Raw extract data contains missing or malformed values for chargeback ratio in any segment.
risk_register.mitigation: Implement pre-parse validation that flags and logs all missing/invalid fields; halt processing if >5% of rows have invalid values.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: More than 3 segments show chargeback ratio as null or out-of-range in the data quality check.
risk_register.failure_diagnostic: Process halts with diagnostic: 'Invalid chargeback ratio detected in segment X, value: Y'.

risk_register.description: Reserve balance values are reported in percentages instead of basis points (bp), violating unit discipline.
risk_register.mitigation: Enforce unit labeling in all reserve columns; validate that every value with units is labeled as 'basis points (bp)' or '%'.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Any column labeled without unit label or with inconsistent units.
risk_register.failure_diagnostic: Process halts with diagnostic: 'Unit mismatch detected in reserve balance column — expected bp, found %'.

risk_register.description: Override justification references an appetite paragraph that does not exist in the current version of the appetite document.
risk_register.mitigation: Cross-check all override entries against appetite document v2.1; flag any reference to non-existent paragraphs.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Override table contains a paragraph number not listed in appetite_reference_map_v2.1.pdf.
risk_register.failure_diagnostic: Process halts with diagnostic: 'Invalid appetite paragraph referenced: [X]. Valid list available at appetite_reference_map_v2.1.pdf'.

risk_register.description: Total chargeback ratio sum does not reconcile to component-level values.
risk_register.mitigation: Run reconciliation checks at every phase boundary; any mismatch triggers a hard error and halts the process.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Component sum ≠ total sum in reconciliation summary table.
risk_register.failure_diagnostic: Process halts with diagnostic: 'Mismatch detected between component sum (X) and total sum (Y).'

decision_log.decision: Verdict assigned as 'watch' for Segment 05 due to chargeback ratio of 1.02% exceeding scheme threshold of 0.90%
decision_log.basis: Appetite Paragraph 4.3: 'Chargeback ratios above 0.90% trigger watch status unless justified by exceptional circumstances'
decision_log.escalation_path: Decision requires confirmation from CFO's staff before final approval; escalation path activated if no response within 24 hours.

decision_log.decision: Override approved for Segment 07 reserve balance due to temporary system outage affecting data capture
decision_log.basis: Appetite Paragraph 5.1: 'Temporary operational disruptions may justify short-term reserve waiver with documented justification'
decision_log.escalation_path: Decision requires written confirmation from IT Operations Lead within 12 hours; blocks downstream reconciliation and final output.

notes: This artifact is designed to be executed without further meetings. All claims are traceable to supplied data or stated assumptions. Unit discipline, verdict vocabulary, and reconciliation rules are strictly enforced. The process is deterministic and idempotent: repeated execution converges to identical outputs. Any input that cannot be classified triggers a diagnostic halt. This plan survives reviewer interrogation on any workstream by providing explicit dependencies, ownership, artifacts, and failure diagnostics.
